summary.text: Bianca Virnig is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 52B, in office since 2024, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Republican Tom Lopac is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Bianca Ward Virnig lives in Eagan, Minnesota, and earned an A.A. from Century College and a B.A. in English from the University of Minnesota.
Her career experience includes working as a director of health and safety at BrightWorks.
Virnig previously served on the Rosemount-Apple Valley-Eagan School Board from 2022 to 2023.
Bianca Virnig defeated Republican Douglas Willetts in the November 5, 2024 general election.
Virnig's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Education Finance Committee, the Human Services Finance and Policy Committee and Elections Finance and Policy.
